selector_priority: Select first available selector in declared fallback order, rather than first ancestor in DOM order.
async_results: Resize/mutation observers realign a replaced results anchor for up to ten seconds; pointer, wheel, touch or keyboard input cancels pending alignment. Different route pathname is never scrolled.
filter: No pathname animation or blanket scroll on query changes.
tests: Priority selectors, delayed replacement, user cancellation, reduced motion and POP restoration.
